skills.name: agent-browser
skills.purpose: Browser automation CLI built for AI agents: navigate, click, fill forms, snapshot accessibility refs, screenshot and extract data with low token use.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on any 'open a site / fill a form / scrape' request; requires installing the agent-browser CLI (npm) and Chromium.
skills.evidence: Vercel Labs; skills.sh 1.0M installs (#2 overall); recommended in multiple 2026 'best skills' roundups; skills.sh trending #15

skills.name: browser-use
skills.purpose: Direct browser control over CDP for automation, scraping, testing and screenshots, with optional Browser Use cloud browsers.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on web interaction tasks; needs the browser-use CLI/Python package; cloud mode needs an API key.
skills.evidence: browser-use 117k stars; skills.sh 96.5K installs

skills.name: playwright-cli
skills.purpose: Token-efficient Playwright CLI for agents: drive browsers, record and run interactions, inspect pages and work with Playwright tests.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on browser automation/testing; install @playwright/cli (Node) which ships the skill.
skills.evidence: Official Microsoft; skills.sh 173K installs; skills.sh trending #167

skills.name: chrome-devtools
skills.purpose: Uses the Chrome DevTools MCP server for browser automation, debugging, network inspection and performance analysis.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when debugging or automating Chrome; requires the chrome-devtools-mcp server configured (not --slim mode).
skills.evidence: Official Chrome DevTools team; repo 52.9k stars
skills.notes: Sibling skills: chrome-devtools-cli, a11y-debugging, memory-leak-debugging, debug-optimize-lcp.

skills.name: computer-use
skills.purpose: Drives the GUI of visible local app windows and browsers via `orca computer`: accessibility tree, clicks, typing, menus, dialogs, screenshots.
skills.how_to_use: Use only when no programmatic path exists; requires Orca installed.
skills.evidence: Orca repo 83.9k stars (created Mar 2026); skills.sh 188K installs, trending #126

skills.name: webapp-testing
skills.purpose: Toolkit for driving local web apps with Python Playwright scripts: verify UI behaviour, capture screenshots and console logs, manage dev servers.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when testing or automating a local web app; needs Python + playwright installed.
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic; skills.sh 169.2K installs; in travisvn, VoltAgent and ComposioHQ lists; skills.sh Hot list #16 this week

skills.name: gws-workflow
skills.purpose: Cross-service Google Workspace workflows via the official gws CLI: standup reports, meeting prep, email-to-task, weekly digests across Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Tasks.
skills.how_to_use: Install the gws CLI and authenticate with Google; invoke for multi-app Workspace automation. Repo ships ~95 per-service/recipe skills (gws-shared covers auth).
skills.evidence: Official Google Workspace repo, 31k stars; skills.sh 32k installs (gws-gmail 79k); not present anywhere in the library
skills.notes: Pick per-service skills (gws-calendar, gws-drive, gws-sheets) from the same repo as needed.

skills.name: gws-gmail
skills.purpose: Send, read, search and manage Gmail from the agent through the gws CLI, with sub-skills for triage, reply, forward and watch.
skills.how_to_use: Requires gws CLI with Google OAuth; triggers on Gmail tasks.
skills.evidence: Official Google Workspace repo, 31k stars; skills.sh 79k installs (most-installed gws skill)
skills.notes: Sends real email: confirm before sending.

skills.name: n8n-workflow-patterns
skills.purpose: Proven n8n workflow architectures (webhooks, HTTP API integration, DB ops, AI agent workflows, batch and scheduled jobs) to design workflows correctly.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when designing n8n workflows; best with the n8n-mcp MCP server connected to an n8n instance.
skills.evidence: Most-installed n8n skill: skills.sh 11.2K; by the n8n-mcp author; in VoltAgent list; aitmpl 358 downloads; recommended on n8n community forum

skills.name: n8n-mcp-tools-expert
skills.purpose: Expert guide to the n8n-mcp toolset: node search, config validation, templates, workflow management, credentials and security audits.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers whenever n8n-mcp tools are used; requires the n8n-mcp server (npx n8n-mcp) and optional n8n API key.
skills.evidence: skills.sh 7.9K installs; same 6.4k-star repo

skills.name: firecrawl
skills.purpose: Any live-web task via the Firecrawl CLI: search, scrape to clean markdown, map/crawl sites, bulk extraction, interaction with pages needing clicks/login, change monitoring.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on web research/scraping; requires the firecrawl CLI and a Firecrawl API key (paid beyond free tier).
skills.evidence: Official Firecrawl; skills.sh 102.4K installs (family of 10+ sub-skills each ~80K); in VoltAgent list
skills.notes: No license file in repo -> link only; paid API.

skills.name: firecrawl-agent
skills.purpose: Autonomously navigates websites and extracts structured data across pages via the Firecrawl CLI.
skills.how_to_use: Use when scraping needs multi-page navigation; needs Firecrawl CLI and API key.
skills.evidence: Official Firecrawl; skills.sh 3.7K installs since Aug 21 2026, on Hot list (firecrawl-search too)

skills.name: chrome-devtools-axi
skills.purpose: Agent-ergonomic Chrome control through the chrome-devtools-axi CLI: navigate, snapshot, click, fill forms, run JS, inspect console/network, screenshots, perf audits.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers whenever a task needs a real browser; install the chrome-devtools-axi CLI.
skills.evidence: skills.sh Hot list #21 this week (4.1K installs)
skills.notes: Thin skill; relies on the CLI

skills.name: gh-axi
skills.purpose: Operates GitHub through the agent-oriented gh-axi CLI: issues, PRs, stacked PRs, Actions runs, releases, Projects, secrets and search.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on any GitHub task; install gh-axi.
skills.evidence: skills.sh Hot list #24 this week (5.0K installs)
skills.notes: Thin skill; relies on the CLI

skills.name: n8n-code-javascript
skills.purpose: Writing JavaScript in n8n Code nodes: $input/$json/$node syntax, helpers for HTTP, DateTime, modes and common error fixes.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when writing JS in an n8n Code node.
skills.evidence: skills.sh 6.8K installs

skills.name: n8n-expression-syntax
skills.purpose: Validates and fixes n8n {{ }} expressions, data mapping between nodes and webhook data references.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when configuring node fields that reference upstream data.
skills.evidence: skills.sh 6.2K installs

skills.name: n8n-workflow-lifecycle-official
skills.purpose: Official n8n guidance for starting, organizing, validating, testing and publishing workflows (layout, sticky notes, naming, folders) via n8n's MCP tools.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on create/update/validate/publish workflow via n8n's official MCP; load router skill using-n8n-skills-official.
skills.evidence: Official n8n (n8n-io); skills.sh 1.9K installs (14-skill official set ~1.5-1.9K each)
skills.notes: Newer official set; overlaps with czlonkowski/n8n-skills.

skills.name: composio
skills.purpose: Use 1000+ external apps (Gmail, Slack, GitHub, CRMs...) through the Composio CLI, or build agents/apps with the Composio SDK and tool router.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when acting in third-party SaaS apps; requires a Composio account/API key and connected accounts.
skills.evidence: Official Composio; skills.sh 6.8K installs
skills.notes: Third-party auth broker; review data access.

skills.name: connect-apps
skills.purpose: Connects Claude to 500+ apps via the Composio plugin so it can actually send email, create issues, post messages, etc.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'send an email / create an issue' style requests; needs the connect-apps plugin and a free Composio API key.
skills.evidence: Composio's 76k-star awesome list; skills.sh 4.1K installs
skills.notes: No LICENSE file in repo (README claims Apache-2.0) -> link only. The same repo hosts ~800 auto-generated '<app>-automation' Composio skills (Gmail, Slack, Notion...) with low installs.

skills.name: zapier-sdk
skills.purpose: Write Zapier SDK (TypeScript) code that runs actions in 9,000+ apps via Zapier's OAuth layer without per-app SDKs; discovers apps/actions and input schemas.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on @zapier/zapier-sdk code; requires a Zapier account and SDK auth.
skills.evidence: Official Zapier; skills.sh 948 installs

skills.name: make-scenario-building
skills.purpose: Designing Make (Integromat) scenarios: module choice, routing/filters/iterators/aggregators, blueprints, deployment, error handling and scheduling.

skills.evidence: Official Make (integromat org); skills.sh 386 installs
skills.notes: New official set, low adoption so far.
